Draft/Notes:
30‑minute Product Review (brainstorming only)

Purpose
- Rapid check on product health, surface key risks, and align on immediate decisions/action owners.

Suggested attendees
- Product lead (facilitator), PM, analytics/BI, eng lead, ops/CS rep, stakeholder (optional)

Pre-reads (optional)
- Current dashboard (top KPIs) and one-page risk summary.

Agenda (30 minutes)
- 0:00–0:02 — Quick opening (objective, timebox, confirm attendees) — Facilitator
- 0:02–0:15 — Metrics (13 min)
  - Present top 3–5 KPIs vs targets/trends (acquisition, engagement, conversion, revenue/ARPU as applicable)
  - Call out anomalies or recent changes and potential drivers
  - Quick clarifying questions (2–3 min)
- 0:15–0:23 — Risks (8 min)
  - Highlight 3 highest-priority risks (technical, operational, market, compliance) and current mitigations
  - Identify any new/emerging risks needing attention
- 0:23–0:29 — Decisions & trade-offs (6 min)
  - List 1–3 decisions needed now (e.g., feature rollout timing, resource reallocation, experiment pause/scale)
  - Capture recommended options, implications, and preferred choice (if any)
- 0:29–0:30 — Next steps & owners (1 min)
  - Confirm immediate actions, owners, and follow-up check-in

Notes for facilitator
- Keep discussion timeboxed; defer deep dives to follow-ups.
- Capture actions and owners in meeting notes.
